# Original SFX compatibility inputs

Self-authored payload is CC0-1.0, unchanged from sfx-155. Thirty groups retain original producer bytes and volume names; all decoded contents were checked independently with official 7-Zip 26.04. Public fixture password: `Sfx158+中文123!`. Never execute any fixture EXE.

The three unmodified 7-Zip GUI modules are LGPL-2.1-or-later, copyright Igor Pavlov; original notices accompany each. Corresponding unmodified source is available from https://www.7-zip.org/a/7z1900-src.7z, https://github.com/ip7z/7zip/releases/download/23.01/7z2301-src.7z and https://github.com/ip7z/7zip/releases/download/26.04/7z2604-src.7z. Installer URLs and hashes, producer/module hashes and exact arguments are fixed in manifest.json. EXEs in external 7Z groups are byte-identical to their original GUI module, not embedded first data volumes.

WinRAR 6.24 module names and hashes are retained with its original license and generated SFX archives. Standalone RAR modules and RAR producers are not redistributed. These are specifically 6.24 GUI/console, x86/x64 originals, not evidence for all historical RAR modules. Its original installer was obtained for v1.4.19; see docs/RAR4_RECOVERY_1.4.19.md for the receipt. No input executable is launched by tests or the product.
